title: Roma Beats Inter 2-1 and Maintains Serie A Lead
seoTitle: Roma Beats Inter 2-1, Stays Top of Serie A
subtitle: Decisive Match on Matchday 5 Puts Gasperini's Team on 15 Points
excerpt: In an thrilling match, Roma defeated Inter 2-1, earning three points that keep them in first place in Serie A with 15 points, while their rival remains.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The match between Roma and Inter Milan, played last Saturday, ended with a 2-1 victory for the capital team. The result kept Roma in the league lead, while Inter remained close behind, with a three-point difference.

How the Game Unfolded

Roma started well, controlling possession (49.2% against Inter's 50.8%) and creating more shots (18 attempts against 9). The first goal came before halftime, securing an early advantage for Gian Piero Gasperini's team.

Inter's Setback and Lautaro Martínez's Reaction

In the second half, Inter increased the pressure and gradually managed to equalize. Lautaro Martínez scored the goal that brought the visitors close to a draw, showcasing the offensive capability of Cristian Chivu's team.

Decisive Moment and the Winning Goal

In the final minutes, Roma reacted quickly with counter-attacks. One of the standout plays was Dybala's move, which helped create the opportunity that resulted in the winning goal, sealing the score at 2-1.

Statistics That Explain the Result

  • Ball Possession: Roma 49.2% – Inter 50.8%
  • Shots: Roma 18 – Inter 9
  • Shots on Target: Roma 4 – Inter 3
  • Accurate Passes: Roma 83.9% – Inter 86.3%
  • Tackles: Roma 10 – Inter 14

Impact on Serie A Standings

With the victory, Roma accumulates 15 points, maintaining the top spot in the table. Inter, with 12 points, remains in second place, still within the Champions League qualification zone.

Expectations for Upcoming Clashes

Both teams continue to seek consistency. Roma is trying to consolidate its lead, while Inter aims to reduce the gap and resume the title race. The upcoming matches promise to keep the competition fierce at the top of Serie A.
